// Generator of go-oracle-filepath.json: what filepath.EvalSymlinks, os.Stat
// and os.ReadDir of the freeze commit's toolchain return on the tree that
// filepath.test.ts builds (the same layout, made here in a temporary folder;
// "<root>" stands for it). Kept as text; regenerate with:
// mkdir /tmp/x && cp go-oracle-filepath.go.txt /tmp/x/main.go && (cd /tmp/x && go run main.go) > go-oracle-filepath.json
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	root, _ := os.MkdirTemp("", "oracle")
	root, _ = filepath.EvalSymlinks(root)
	defer func() {
		_ = os.Chmod(filepath.Join(root, "noperm"), 0o755)
		_ = os.RemoveAll(root)
	}()
	must := func(err error) {
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
	// The tree.
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "dir", "sub"), 0o755))
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "file"), []byte("x"), 0o644))
	must(os.Symlink(filepath.Join(root, "dir"), filepath.Join(root, "link-dir")))
	must(os.Symlink("file", filepath.Join(root, "link-file")))
	must(os.Symlink("../dir", filepath.Join(root, "dir", "link-up")))
	must(os.Symlink("nope", filepath.Join(root, "dangling")))
	must(os.Symlink("loop-b", filepath.Join(root, "loop-a")))
	must(os.Symlink("loop-a", filepath.Join(root, "loop-b")))
	must(os.Symlink("/", filepath.Join(root, "link-root")))
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "noperm", "inner"), 0o755))
	must(os.Chmod(filepath.Join(root, "noperm"), 0o000))

	hide := func(s string) string { return strings.ReplaceAll(s, root, "<root>") }
	errText := func(err error) string {
		if err == nil {
			return ""
		}
		return hide(err.Error())
	}

	type evalCase struct{ In, Out, Err string }
	var evals []evalCase
	for _, rel := range []string{"", "dir", "dir/", "dir/./sub/", "dir/../file", "file", "file/x", "nope", "nope/x", "link-dir/sub",
		"link-file", "link-file/x", "dangling", "dangling/x", "loop-a", "dir/link-up/sub", "dir/link-up/link-up/..", "noperm",
		"noperm/inner", "dir/sub/../../file", "link-root/", "dir//sub", "dir/.."} {
		out, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(root + "/" + rel)
		evals = append(evals, evalCase{rel, hide(out), errText(err)})
	}

	type statCase struct{ In, IsDir, StatErr, ReadDirErr string }
	var stats []statCase
	for _, rel := range []string{"dir", "file", "file/x", "nope", "noperm", "noperm/inner", "dangling", "loop-a", "link-dir"} {
		c := statCase{In: rel}
		info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, rel))
		c.StatErr = errText(err)
		if err == nil && info.IsDir() {
			c.IsDir = "yes"
		}
		_, err = os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, rel))
		c.ReadDirErr = errText(err)
		stats = append(stats, c)
	}

	type pathCase struct{ In, Dir, Base string }
	var paths []pathCase
	for _, p := range []string{"", "/", "a", "/a", "/a/", "/a/b", "a/b/", "//a//b//", ".", "..", "/a/..", "a/../.."} {
		paths = append(paths, pathCase{p, filepath.Dir(p), filepath.Base(p)})
	}
	type joinCase struct {
		In  []string
		Out string
	}
	var joins []joinCase
	for _, in := range [][]string{{}, {""}, {"", ""}, {"a", "b"}, {"/a", "../b"}, {"a", "", "b"}, {"", "a"}, {"/", "a"}, {"a/", "/b/"}} {
		if in == nil {
			in = []string{}
		}
		joins = append(joins, joinCase{in, filepath.Join(in...)})
	}

	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	_ = enc.Encode(map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "Go 1.27.3 standard library on darwin/arm64, the toolchain of the freeze commit 238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
		"evalSymlinks": evals,
		"stat":         stats,
		"paths":        paths,
		"joins":        joins,
	})
}
